title: CARRY:
body: CARRY: Conductor's own code reads 49 files that the docs family moved into the store, listed in the commit's `.andromeda/db/moved` `product` row: the capture population and the digest pins of crates/conductor-run/tests (delegated_timing_harvest, lifecycle_harvest, real_model_harvest, real_model_grading/capture_population.rs, real_model_series/mod.rs, evidence_pin) and the roster's `citation_home` in scripts/mutation-roster.toml. They stand byte-equal in the tree under conductor-*/chunks/ only for those readers. This chunk copies what the tests read to a fixture folder inside the crate, keeps every sha256 pin as it stands, re-points the path constants and `capture_population.rs`'s `read_dir`, re-points each `citation_home` to a file that stays in the tree, then runs `python -X utf8 {tools_dir}/rec.py render --root . --family spine --reconcile --product {what the row names but the 49, or none}` and `git rm`s the 49. Green: `cargo test -p conductor-run --locked` and scripts/mutation-gate.py's roster check, with no path under conductor-*/chunks/ left in crates/ or scripts/ but what names history in a comment.

title: CARRY:
body: CARRY: the spine's deletion left a product render for this code alone — crates/conductor-report/tests/matrix_ledger_gate.rs reads each version's requirements.md and verification-matrix.json, retired files that .andromeda/db/moved keeps rendered until this flips. Flip it in this chunk: read each version's coverage.md, whose "- {id} · {title}" lines name every capability once, and hold the unique and no-P-NNN arms there; the set-equality arm has no subject now, since a requirement's line lives on its capability node. Then fire rec.py render --root . --family spine --reconcile --product {what the row names but the six, or none} and git rm the six files, in this chunk's commit.
